dialogues.jp:
また、この前の事を考えている。頭の下に両手
を差し込んで、ベッドに寝ころんで。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't think of anything else but that. I was lying on
my bed, hands behind my head.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't think of anything else but that. I was lying on
my bed, hands behind my head.

dialogues.jp: この前のこと──一昨日のＴＤＬのことを。
dialogues.en: By "that", I meant yesterday's TDL.
dialogues.text: By "that", I meant yesterday's TDL.

dialogues.jp: ことりは終始楽しそうだった。
dialogues.en: From beginning to end, she was enjoying herself.
dialogues.text: From beginning to end, she was enjoying herself.

dialogues.jp: ことりは終始笑顔を浮かべていた。
dialogues.en: From beginning to end, she was smiling.
dialogues.text: From beginning to end, she was smiling.

dialogues.jp: はしゃいで。
dialogues.en: Laughing.
dialogues.text: Laughing.

dialogues.jp: 喋って。
dialogues.en: Talking.
dialogues.text: Talking.

dialogues.jp:
高い割りに美味しくもないホットドッグにかぶ
りついて。
dialogues.en: Eating an expensive and tasteless hot dog.
dialogues.text: Eating an expensive and tasteless hot dog.

dialogues.jp:
ジェットコースターに乗って、両手を万歳のよ
うにして。
dialogues.en: Screaming as she rode the jet coaster, hands up in the air.
dialogues.text: Screaming as she rode the jet coaster, hands up in the air.

dialogues.jp: お化け屋敷では、俺にしがみついてきて。
dialogues.en: Gripping tightly onto me as we explored the haunted house.
dialogues.text: Gripping tightly onto me as we explored the haunted house.

dialogues.jp:
一日中遊んだ。休日の、本当に充実した過ごし
方。なのに……。
dialogues.en:
We spent the whole day there. We really made full use of the
holiday. Yet...
dialogues.text:
We spent the whole day there. We really made full use of the
holiday. Yet...

dialogues.jp:
このもやもやは、一体なんなのだろう？　すっ
きりしない。胸がむかついて仕方がない。
dialogues.en:
What is this haziness I get? The irritating feeling in my
chest that I had to ignore...
dialogues.text:
What is this haziness I get? The irritating feeling in my
chest that I had to ignore...

dialogues.jp: いや、本当は分かっている。
dialogues.en: No, in truth, I knew.
dialogues.text: No, in truth, I knew.

dialogues.jp:
ことりと一緒に時間を過ごした気がしなかった
のだ。
dialogues.en:
The Kotori I spent the whole day with, didn't feel like
Kotori.
dialogues.text:
The Kotori I spent the whole day with, didn't feel like
Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
妄想だか遺影だかを胸に、一緒に過ごした気に
なったという、ただそれだけのような。
dialogues.en:
I had wild delusions of resurrections and clonings, but
waved them off quickly.
dialogues.text:
I had wild delusions of resurrections and clonings, but
waved them off quickly.

dialogues.jp: 寝返りを打つ。ぎしっと、ベッドが鳴った。
dialogues.en: I turned around to face the bed. And yelled into it.
dialogues.text: I turned around to face the bed. And yelled into it.

dialogues.jp:
俺が好きだったことりは、どこに行ってしまっ
たのだろう？
dialogues.en: Where has Kotori, the Kotori I love, gone to?
dialogues.text: Where has Kotori, the Kotori I love, gone to?

dialogues.jp:
湖面に映った星を相手にしている天文学者のよ
うな、そんな｛むな／虚｝しさを覚える。
dialogues.en:
I start remembering how she used to be, like staring into
your reflection in a river.
dialogues.text:
I start remembering how she used to be, like staring into
your reflection in a river.

dialogues.jp:
いつだったか、俺は、お互いが虚像を見つめ合っ
ているといった考えを持った事があった。
dialogues.en: Was the impression I had of her then just a facade?
dialogues.text: Was the impression I had of her then just a facade?

dialogues.jp:
今では、そんな馬鹿げた考えが、堪え難いくら
いに強くなってしまっているのだ……。
dialogues.en: I couldn't bear to think about it any longer...
dialogues.text: I couldn't bear to think about it any longer...

dialogues.en: "...The phone's ringing,"
dialogues.text: "...The phone's ringing,"

dialogues.jp: 家の電話だ。１階で鳴っている。
dialogues.en: It's the house phone, on the 1st floor.
dialogues.text: It's the house phone, on the 1st floor.

dialogues.jp: ｛おっくう／億劫｝だった。しばらくすれば、切れるだろう。
dialogues.en:
How troublesome. I hope whoever is on the line just gives
up.
dialogues.text:
How troublesome. I hope whoever is on the line just gives
up.

dialogues.jp: 「くそっ」
dialogues.en: "Damnit."
dialogues.text: "Damnit."

dialogues.jp:
受話器を取る。がちゃんという音。相手は、公
衆電話からかけているらしい。
dialogues.en:
I picked up the receiver, and heard a crash. Whoever's on
the line must be calling from a public phone.
dialogues.text:
I picked up the receiver, and heard a crash. Whoever's on
the line must be calling from a public phone.

dialogues.jp: 「……もしもし？」
dialogues.en: "...Hello?"
dialogues.text: "...Hello?"

dialogues.jp:
不機嫌な声が出てしまう。受話器の向こうで、
息を呑んだような音が聞こえた。
dialogues.en:
My voice had a touch of irritation to it. I could hear light
breaths from the receiver.
dialogues.text:
My voice had a touch of irritation to it. I could hear light
breaths from the receiver.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『その……ことりです』
dialogues.en: "It's... Kotori."
dialogues.text: "It's... Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「えっ？　あ、ことり？　悪い、ことりだとは
　思わなかった。その……ことりって、電話が
　苦手だって言ってたからさ」
dialogues.en:
"Eh? Ah, Kotori? Sorry, I didn't think it was you. After
all... you said that you didn't like using phones."
dialogues.text:
"Eh? Ah, Kotori? Sorry, I didn't think it was you. After
all... you said that you didn't like using phones."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
『……今となっては、こっちの方が気が楽だか
　ら』
dialogues.en: "...I can't say I'm happy to do this right now either."
dialogues.text: "...I can't say I'm happy to do this right now either."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「…………？　そう。それで……どうしたの？
　今、外か？」
dialogues.en: "......? T, then... what happened? Are you outside?"
dialogues.text: "......? T, then... what happened? Are you outside?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
『うん……その、ね。プレゼントを……プレゼ
　ントを探そうと思って……』
dialogues.en: "Yeah... I'm looking for, you know... a present..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah... I'm looking for, you know... a present..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「プレゼント？　なんの？　というか、こんな
　時間にか？」
dialogues.en: "Present? What present? And at this time?"
dialogues.text: "Present? What present? And at this time?"

dialogues.jp:
都会ならいざ知らず、初音島ではもう眠りにつ
いている時間と言えた。
dialogues.en: At this time, most of hatsunejima was sleeping.
dialogues.text: At this time, most of hatsunejima was sleeping.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『結婚式の……お姉ちゃんの、結婚式の……』
dialogues.en: "The wedding ceremony... my sister's wedding ceremony..."
dialogues.text: "The wedding ceremony... my sister's wedding ceremony..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「は？　ちょ、ちょっと待ってくれよ」
dialogues.en: "Huh? H, hold up a bit."
dialogues.text: "Huh? H, hold up a bit."

dialogues.jp: 受話器をぎゅっと握りしめる。
dialogues.en: My grip on the receiver tightened.
dialogues.text: My grip on the receiver tightened.

dialogues.jp:
「プレゼントはもう決めただろう？　歌を……
　歌うんだろう？」
dialogues.en:
"I thought the present was decided already? You would...
sing for her, right?"
dialogues.text:
"I thought the present was decided already? You would...
sing for her, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『……聖歌隊で……』
dialogues.en: "...At the choir..."
dialogues.text: "...At the choir..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
『聖歌隊でソロがあったのに……やっぱり、私、
　きちんと歌えなかったから……』
dialogues.en:
"I found out at the choir... in the end, I really can't sing
anymore..."
dialogues.text:
"I found out at the choir... in the end, I really can't sing
anymore..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『もうね、歌う理由がないから。だから私……』
dialogues.en: "I don't have a reason to sing anymore, so I..."
dialogues.text: "I don't have a reason to sing anymore, so I..."

dialogues.jp:
淡々と、乾いた声音。ひび割れている。あの素
晴らしい歌声の持ち主とは、到底思えない。
dialogues.en:
Her voice was plain and dry, cracking occasionally. This
can't be the owner of the beautiful singing voice that I
heard before...
dialogues.text:
Her voice was plain and dry, cracking occasionally. This
can't be the owner of the beautiful singing voice that I
heard before...

dialogues.jp:
俺の知っていることりと、受話器の向こうのこ
とりは、どうしたってイコールで結ばれない。
dialogues.en:
The Kotori I knew, and the Kotori on the other side of the
phone, really had no linkage whatsoever.
dialogues.text:
The Kotori I knew, and the Kotori on the other side of the
phone, really had no linkage whatsoever.

dialogues.jp: 「……今、どこに居る？　迎えに行くよ」
dialogues.en: "...Where are you now? I'd go out and meet you."
dialogues.text: "...Where are you now? I'd go out and meet you."

dialogues.jp: とにかく、電話じゃラチがあかない。
dialogues.en: In any case, the phone isn't the best place for this.
dialogues.text: In any case, the phone isn't the best place for this.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『……ううん、もう、帰るから』
dialogues.en: "...Never mind. I'm going home now."
dialogues.text: "...Never mind. I'm going home now."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ほんとか？」
dialogues.en: "...Really?"
dialogues.text: "...Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
『ほんとにほんと……もう、お姉ちゃんが迎え
　に来てくれるから』
dialogues.en: "Really... I asked my sister to come fetch me already."
dialogues.text: "Really... I asked my sister to come fetch me already."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
『ちょっと、喋りたかっただけなの。声が聞き
　たかっただけなの……それじゃ』
dialogues.en:
"I just wanted to talk to you a little and hear your
voice... goodbye."
dialogues.text:
"I just wanted to talk to you a little and hear your
voice... goodbye."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あっ」
ガチャン。ツーツー。……。
dialogues.en: Slam, beep, beep...
dialogues.text: Slam, beep, beep...

dialogues.jp:
別れの挨拶もしないまま、耳には、単調な電子
音だけが聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en: Instead of a farewell, all I could hear was the dial tone.
dialogues.text: Instead of a farewell, all I could hear was the dial tone.

dialogues.jp: 俺はすぐに、暦先生の携帯電話に連絡を入れた。
dialogues.en:
I immediately tried to contact Koyomi-sensei on her cell
phone, but a thought came to my mind.
dialogues.text:
I immediately tried to contact Koyomi-sensei on her cell
phone, but a thought came to my mind.

dialogues.jp:
ことりの言っていた事は嘘ではなく、暦先生は、
車で迎えに行くところだと言った。
dialogues.en:
If Kotori was telling the truth, Koyomi-sensei would be in
her car driving about now...
dialogues.text:
If Kotori was telling the truth, Koyomi-sensei would be in
her car driving about now...

dialogues.en: "Haah..."
dialogues.text: "Haah..."

dialogues.jp: どさっとベッドに身を投げ出す。
dialogues.en: I fell back onto my bed.
dialogues.text: I fell back onto my bed.

dialogues.jp: 「一体、どうなってんだよ……」
dialogues.en: "What on earth is happening..."
dialogues.text: "What on earth is happening..."

dialogues.jp:
ことりはおかしい。やっぱり、明らかにおかし
い。杉並だったら、宇宙人とすり替わってしまっ
ていると｛わめ／喚｝き出すところだ。
dialogues.en:
Kotori was being weird. Strangely, her being cheerful was
already weird enough. If Suginami was here, he'd be
suspecting aliens.
dialogues.text:
Kotori was being weird. Strangely, her being cheerful was
already weird enough. If Suginami was here, he'd be
suspecting aliens.

dialogues.jp: 「いつからなんだろう……？」
dialogues.en: "When did this start happening...?"
dialogues.text: "When did this start happening...?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりがことりでなくなってしまった、決定的
な瞬間は。
dialogues.en:
There was a definite time when Kotori... stopped being
Kotori.
dialogues.text:
There was a definite time when Kotori... stopped being
Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
記憶をさらう。そんな昔の事じゃない。つい、
最近のこと……。
dialogues.en:
I wracked my brain. It had to have happened quite
recently... what major things happened recently...
dialogues.text:
I wracked my brain. It had to have happened quite
recently... what major things happened recently...

dialogues.jp: がばっと──跳ね起きた。
dialogues.en: I sprung up from bed.
dialogues.text: I sprung up from bed.

dialogues.jp: 「……あの桜が枯れてしまってから、か？」
dialogues.en: "...When the sakura petals withered...?"
dialogues.text: "...When the sakura petals withered...?"

dialogues.jp:
考えてみれば、俺に訪れた変化も、その日を境
にしているようだ。
dialogues.en:
It was exactly that day that I started seeing the changes in
Kotori.
dialogues.text:
It was exactly that day that I started seeing the changes in
Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
同じような変化が、ことりに起こったと、どう
して言えないことがあるだろう……？
dialogues.en:
But those changes that happened to Kotori, why didn't she
talk about them...?
dialogues.text:
But those changes that happened to Kotori, why didn't she
talk about them...?

dialogues.jp: ことりには……どんな変化が起こった？
dialogues.en: What kind of changes... happened to her in the first place?"
dialogues.text: What kind of changes... happened to her in the first place?"

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりに訪れた変化◆
dialogues.en: ◆The Changes in Kotori◆
dialogues.text: ◆The Changes in Kotori◆

dialogues.jp:
ことりの事について思い悩んでいると、電話が
掛かってきた。当の本人からだ。
dialogues.en:
While thinking about Kotori, the phone rang, and it was the
person herself.
dialogues.text:
While thinking about Kotori, the phone rang, and it was the
person herself.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは、歌う理由がなくなったと言った。暦
先生へのプレゼントは歌だと言うのに、それも
なげうって……。
dialogues.en:
Kotori said that she had no reason to sing anymore. So she
couldn't sing as Koyomi-sensei's present...
dialogues.text:
Kotori said that she had no reason to sing anymore. So she
couldn't sing as Koyomi-sensei's present...

dialogues.jp:
外からの電話らしく、迎えに行くと言うと、や
んわりと拒否され、そして切れた。
dialogues.en:
She sounded like she was outside, so I offered to meet her,
but was rejected and she hung up.
dialogues.text:
She sounded like she was outside, so I offered to meet her,
but was rejected and she hung up.

dialogues.jp:
ことりに訪れた変化。それは一体いつからなの
だろう？
dialogues.en: When exactly did Kotori started changing?
dialogues.text: When exactly did Kotori started changing?

dialogues.jp:
考えて、ふと思い至った。それは、桜が枯れた
日からなんじゃないのか？
dialogues.en:
When I thought about it, I came to a realization. Wasn't it
the day that the sakura petals withered?
dialogues.text:
When I thought about it, I came to a realization. Wasn't it
the day that the sakura petals withered?
